record.paper_title: Some open problems in mathematical two-dimensional conformal field theory
record.original_question: Let V be a simple C2-cofinite vertex operator algebra with V(0)=C1, V(n)=0 for n<0, V' equivalent to V, and every grading-restricted generalized V-module completely reducible, and let G be a finite group of automorphisms of V. Do the twisted intertwining operators among the g-twisted V-modules, for all g in G, satisfy associativity, commutativity, and modular invariance?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 6.1. Let V be a vertex operator algebra satisfying the two conditions in Conjecture 5.1. Assume that in addition every grading-restricted generalized V-module is completely reducible. Let G be a finite group of automorphisms of V. Then the twisted intertwining operators among the g-twisted V-modules for all g in G satisfy the associativity, commutativity and modular invariance properties.

artifact.category_tag: Vertex operator algebras and orbifold CFT
artifact.status_search_result: Progress has been made on parts of the conjecture: twisted intertwining operators for non-commuting automorphisms have been defined and studied, and recent work establishes skew-symmetry, contragredient isomorphisms, G-crossed commutativity/braiding isomorphisms, and a modular invariance theorem for (logarithmic) intertwining operators among grading-restricted generalized V-modules. However, the full conjecture asserting associativity, commutativity, and modular invariance jointly for twisted intertwining operators among all g-twisted V-modules under the stated hypotheses does not appear to be fully established as of 2026.

status_evidence.title: Twisted intertwining operators and tensor products of (generalized) twisted modules
status_evidence.snippet: Constructs G-crossed commutativity and braiding isomorphisms; proves skew-symmetry and contragredient isomorphisms for twisted intertwining operators.
status_evidence.claim: Partial structural results (G-crossed braiding/commutativity) for twisted intertwining operators are established, but full associativity/modular invariance under the conjecture's hypotheses is not asserted.

status_evidence.title: Modular Invariance of (Logarithmic) Intertwining Operators
status_evidence.snippet: Spaces spanned by pseudo-q-traces of products of (logarithmic) intertwining operators are invariant under modular transformations.
status_evidence.claim: Modular invariance is proved in the untwisted logarithmic setting; the twisted/orbifold version is the remaining ingredient.

status_evidence.title: Intertwining operators among twisted modules associated to not-necessarily-commuting automorphisms
status_evidence.snippet: Introduces twisted intertwining operators for non-commuting automorphisms.
status_evidence.claim: Foundational framework exists but the conjectured trio of properties is not fully proved there.
